step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows an AWS ETL data pipeline divided into three sections: extract, process/transform, and serve. On the left under 'Data Sources', there are two database icons representing internal on-premises databases (OnPremDC) and external third-party bureau sources (ThirdParty). Both feed data via arrows into AWS DMS (DMS). DMS loads raw data into an S3 bucket ('RAW'). Next to RAW and Glue, KMS and Lambda icons are present. S3 RAW feeds into AWS Glue for processing. AWS Glue writes transformed data to an S3 bucket ('PROCESSED') and loads data into AWS Aurora PostgreSQL ('AURORA PG'). Finally, Aurora PG serves data to Tableau for reporting and analytics.
